title: Sir Amberwood's Report
wikitext:
'''Sir Amberwood's Report''' is acquired from [[Sir Amberwood]]. ==As a quest objective== * {{questlong|Alliance|32|The Messenger Of Northwind}} ==Contains== {{Book|content= Most reverent [[Katrana Prestor|Lady Prestor]],
Our military efforts are entirely focused on the jousting tournament, just like you ordered. While it still leaves me at unease to not have my best soldiers nearby, I understand the sacrifices I need to make for great change to happen. [[Lord Amberwood|My brother]] acts like a hapless child grasping at any straw he can get to bring the situation under control again. The other foolish nobles support him, but they will soon see the truth behind his incompetence. Soon we will remedy my father's mistake so many years ago, all thanks to your glorious assistance. Please give me more time to strike at the perfect moment, you will not be disappointed, milady. - Sir Nathaniel Amberwood }} ==Patch changes== * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] '''[https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?f=63&t=21191 Hotfix] (2025-08-20):''' Corrected the text of Sir Amberwood's Report. * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}} [[Category:Readable items]] [[Category:Quest items]]
